name: Chess
description: Interactive chess game with AI analysis. Play chess against a computer opponent while the chatbot provides commentary and advice.
author: ChatBridge

tools.name: start_game
tools.description: Start a new chess game. Call this when the user wants to play chess.

player_color.description: Which color the player wants to play as

tools.name: make_move
tools.description: Make a chess move using algebraic notation. Example: 'e2e4' moves pawn from e2 to e4, 'Nf3' moves knight to f3, 'O-O' for kingside castling.

move.description: Move in algebraic notation (e.g., e2e4, Nf3, O-O for castling)

tools.name: get_board_state
tools.description: Get the current board state including position, legal moves, and game status.

tools.name: analyze_position
tools.description: Analyze the current chess position and suggest best moves with explanations.
